scope: Real G1 encoder + H2 decoder + MuJoCo posture and speed response; no rendered-pose replay. Isolated stop-blend parameter sweep; source bank/controller/production files unchanged.
limitations: Engineering regression limits, not hardware safety guarantees or exact target-speed accuracy.
State checks are at 50 Hz policy boundaries.
No browser rendering, worker scheduling or real-time pacing is tested.

stoppingSummary.reason: At both speeds, .25s produces the lowest second-2, second-3 and second-4 trailing 1s speed RMS among all six sampled values. No case fell and all cases passed unchanged posture limits.
stoppingSummary.limitation: None satisfies the <.25m/s stop-RMS limit by second 2. At speed4 the .25s candidate still has .333m/s RMS during stop seconds2..3. This only compares one stopping gait phase after 7 seconds forward motion; it is not a universal safety or direction/mode-transition validation.

archiveSummary.omission: Only array-valued samples properties were removed recursively. Their lengths are retained as sampleCount. Numeric samples counts and all other metrics, thresholds, provenance, failures, source hashes and sourceChanges are preserved.
